description: This file contains platform-specific script functions for upgrading firmware in an OpenWrt-based environment, including functions for checking the image and performing upgrades based on board name.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity of the provided firmware image. Currently always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade process, selecting the default upgrade method based on the board name.
